title: game-kit chat story (docs/standard-chat.md)
description: A chat-fiction story as loaded by js/chat.js loadStory(). js/chat-schema.js validateStory() applies the same rules plus the cross-reference checks JSON Schema cannot express (dangling targets, unknown speakers / channels / images). Story files are JS modules (export default {...}); validate the object, or JSON.stringify it for an editor.

app.description: name of the fictional messenger app (call screen, talk list)

format.description: what kind of chat this is

player.description: the speaker the player acts as (a key of characters)

lines.description: notation of docs/standard-chat.md: [channel], 21:02 name：text, ［画像#key：caption］, @tag args, ?flag line

text.description: a string, or [{ if, text }, ..., "fallback"] (first match wins)

screen.description: text-only intro / outro screen: paragraphs separated by a blank line, optional generated photo (no text in it)

reveal.description: show the paragraphs one by one on a tap

color.description: name tag / bubble edge / avatar ring (C15)

face.description: key of the generated face image (people only)

voice.description: personality, catch phrases, reply speed and length, emoji / sticker habits, standing, fears, rumours (C3). Writer-facing; not shown

kind.description: unknown = a sender the app shows no name for; registerSpeakerKind() draws a kind yourself

faceless.description: no face by design (the player): no face warning

showName.description: show the name above the first bubble even in a 1:1 talk

tintText.description: text colour on the tint bubble

profile.description: the profile sheet (avatar tap): full name, status, rows [label, text], a note about the player

minor.description: an extra (anonymous poster): no voice needed

tint.description: bubble colour of this person's messages

tts.description: VOICEVOX speaker for generated voice lines

type.description: talk | call | board | a registerChannelType() id

skin.description: legacy channel hint (call / board / group / support / dm); mapped to type

rel.description: second line of the name in the talk list (e.g. 高校の友人)

list.description: false: not in the talk list

static.description: a read-only old talk (not part of the story): date lines and 名前：本文 lines

time.description: time label of a static talk in the list

caption.description: false: alt is for screen readers only, not shown under the picture; a string: the long caption of the result photo (ending card, viewer)

overlays.description: HTML text / box parts drawn over the picture in % of its size (never part of a generated picture)

html.description: an HTML document drawn as a picture (instead of src)

credit.description: VOICEVOX:character name; required for generated voices

widget.description: registerWidget() id for a ［ウィジェット#key］ bubble

album.description: false: not collected in the album

word.description: the words of the sticker, shown as page text (never part of a generated picture)

node.description: exactly one exit: choices | next | branch | ending | done

backlog.description: the earlier conversation, already read: shown at once, no sound, no unread

kind.description: free label instead of the type label

group.description: the road this ending belongs to (records list)

reader.description: a reader-involving ending: no after-story by design

inlineAfter.description: the later-day part is written inline in the nodes (it contains a reply of the player)

photo.description: key of images: shows the result (C16)
